notes: Zone core_ways: the through roads and walks of the core area. Generated by /tmp/claude-0/p5/core/core_ways/gen.py (with walks.py, fitlib.py, roads.py, extra.py, overrides.json); the JSON is the source now and may be edited by hand. Chapin Drive and Skyline Way: one asphalt ring on the shared lines of footprint.json (Chapin 6.87 m, rms 0.12/0.11 m on its edges at 7.5 cm; Skyline 6.5 m, UNVERIFIED, under trees). Junction: the north-west corner is a 6 m true arc, UNVERIFIED (shade and trees hide it; the 2020 ortho shows building works there). South of y -170 the footprint keeps only the east 1.2 m of Skyline Way, so the ring is cut on x -61.0 and y -169.6 and the south-west corner stays with the main model's Lot 9 apron and curb island. West end 0.5 m under College Avenue's hand curb (x -205.9 north edge, -207.9 south edge). Curbs on the edge lines, broken where a walk meets the road end-on (ramps), at the crosswalks, along Lot 10 (its mouth: core_lots) and along the roadside parking bays at x -177..-157 (core_lots). Paint: four continental crosswalks on Chapin Drive read at 7.5 cm (x -167.4, -139.3, -115.4, -92.6; bars 0.5 m at 1.0 m). The ortho shows no centre line on Chapin Drive (profiles across it at five places) and Skyline Way is under trees, so no centre line is drawn; no stop bar at Chapin's mouth is visible (shade), so none is drawn. A band of reddish pavers crosses Chapin where the diagonal walk crosses at x -205 (brick). Walks: 122 strips from OpenStreetMap footways. 102 were fitted to the 2020 ortho: the OSM line was simplified (0.8 m), the walk band (bright, not green) measured across it every 0.5 m, and each run refitted as a straight line through the band centres by least squares with outliers rejected; 84 runs fitted, rms median 0.17 m, 90th percentile 0.45 m; runs under trees or with rms over 0.6 m keep the OSM line (their strips say so). Width: median of the band widths, rounded to 0.2 m, when at least 15 readings fall in 1.2..4.6 m; otherwise 2.4 m (6.0 m on the promenade), UNVERIFIED. Corners turning less than 25 degrees between short runs (OSM curves) get true arcs using 45 % of each run; other corners a small rounding (1.5 m of run). 20 strips follow OSM only: the Alumni Green north part and the ground east of Cole Hall and south of Morehead Hall, rebuilt after the 2020 ortho (which shows the works): fresh OSM footways 1554281914..1554282789 and the other OSM lines there, which the published model's post-2020 walks follow (measured: their centres within 0.1 m of OSM, 3.0 m wide); width 3.0 m and concrete as in Joe's photos of 2026-11-20 (concrete walks with brick edging; reference only). Walks are cut 0.3 m past the footprint (the ground ends at it; the hand paving overlaps the footprint by 0.25 m), out of the College of Communication and Media's volumes, out of the carriageway, 1 m clear of Red Hawk Catholic (OSM 232850502; its apron is core_grounds') and 0.5 m clear of the two Science Quad ponds; walks along the footprint edge keep their centre far enough in that no edge lies more than 1 m outside. Pieces under 25 m2 that the ortho shows as lawn were dropped. Steps in OSM are drawn as plain walks (the engine has no steps), UNVERIFIED. Also drawn from the ortho: the brick plaza at x -70..-32, y 123..152 (OSM pedestrian area 313024784, a Footpaths_OSM strip in the tiles), the service drive east of Life Hall and the College of Communication and Media (lawn in the tiles) and the service yard south of Life Hall (lawn in the tiles). Not drawn: 232850527: a 2 m stub on the College of Communication and Media dock apron (hand-made, outside); 232850574: runs round the walls of Red Hawk Catholic under trees; its entrance apron and drive are core_grounds'; 918882811: footbridge over the pond: the engine has no bridge, and walks do not cross water; 918882812: footbridge over the pond: the engine has no bridge, and walks do not cross water; walks the ortho shows that OSM does not map (they are lawn in the tiles today: the curved walk south of the circle north of Dickson Hall, spurs to doors); the low brick wall on the plaza's north edge (core_grounds); lamps: none drawn (no source shows a lamp without a published lamp post within 2 m was checked; the main model's posts stay). Slits of the footprint are crossed straight; the engine drops the triangles in them.
